map.purpose: The SPA shell of VN-STOCK-AI-PRO (React 19 + Vite 6 + Tailwind v4). It boots the app (index.html -> src/main.tsx), provides the global providers (TanStack Query v5, one top-level error boundary), and keeps a zustand store that also acts as the router (there is no router library: currentView + pushState/popstate). It also holds the shared data hooks every page uses for market, analysis, recommendation and trading data, the app chrome (Header with search and index ribbon, Sidebar, Footer, CommandPalette, mobile bottom nav), and the shared UI primitives in src/components/ui.

map.data_flow: Request -> express.json -> correlationMiddleware -> securityHeaders -> lane router or inline handler -> service/repository (Drizzle Postgres via src/db) or market service (realMarketDataService -> providers/kbs/KbsHistoricalProvider, protected) -> JSON. findings.title: Login/password rate limit uses one global key: 10 bad logins per minute lock every user out; rate limiting also keys on the proxy IP (no trust proxy)

findings.title: CanonicalDataApiRouter rewritten: ingest returns success without persisting, fabricates trading value, hard-codes HOSE identity

findings.title: EOD ingestion job is a no-op that reports COMPLETE; the backfill script exits 0

findings.title: EodIngestionScheduler stub: server crashes at startup when EOD_INGEST_ENABLED=true
findings.description: start() returns void and the class has no status(). server.ts's listen callback runs `void eodScheduler.start().then(...)` and then `eodScheduler.status()`.
